notes.title: Playtesters Wanted for Behind the Beyond Part 1!
notes.notes:
[p]It’s finally happening — Part 1 of [i]Behind the Beyond[/i] is soon entering the [b]early testing[/b] phase, and we’re looking for adventurous souls to help shape the game before release![/p][p]This is the first major chapter of the full story — the real deal, not the demo — and we need sharp eyes, puzzle-solving skills, and honest feedback.[/p][p][b]What we’re looking for:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Detailed feedback — not just “it’s good,” but [i]what worked, what didn’t, what confused you, what you loved[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Story & puzzle consistency notes — if anything feels off or too easy/hard.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug reports — send them our way so we can squash them![/p][/*][/list][p][b]Please note:[/b]
⚠️ Expect a few rough edges — for example, there's no voice-over yet, and the game will only be available in English for this test. (We will do the rest a little later.)[/p][p][b]How to join the playtest:[/b]
1️⃣ Fill out the quick signup form here: [url="https://forms.gle/C1xXavnEQmEctndj6"]https://forms.gle/C1xXavnEQmEctndj6[/url]
2️⃣ Get your Steam key
3️⃣ Join our Discord server: [url="https://discord.com/invite/fcmJt65Prm"]https://discord.com/invite/fcmJt65Prm[/url] — we’ll add you to the super exclusive Testing Channel with all the details.[/p][p]If you’re comfortable, you can even share your screen while playing so we can watch how you interact with the game in real-time — seeing how you think, how you approach a problem is super valuable for us![/p][p][b]Spots are limited[/b] — so if you want to help shape [i]Behind the Beyond[/i] and be part of its journey, sign up now![/p][p]💛 Thank you in advance to everyone who jumps in — your feedback is what will make our game shine![/p]

notes.title: Behind the Beyond is coming to Early Access
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we are planning to release Behind the Beyond in Early Access this year! We bet you have lots of questions about that, so here are some of the most important details.

[b]What is Early Access?[/b]
Early Access is a Steam feature that lets developers release their games before development is fully finished. Once we enter Early Access, the game will be available for anyone to buy and play immediately, while we continue developing the game.

[b]Will I have to buy the full game too when it leaves Early Access?[/b]
No. 
If you buy the game in Early Access, you are buying the full game. But unlike with a pre-purchase, you don't have to wait until the game is fully released to actually play it.

[b]Why should you get involved in Early Access?[/b]
We have two good reasons for you.
💬 First, because you will be able to provide feedback about the game, its features, the story or anything else you'd like, and we can make changes to the game based on that. We've found such feedback extremely helpful in the past!
💰 Second, while the game is in Early Access, you will be able to buy the game for a reduced price.

[b]Isn't it going to spoil the story though?[/b]
No.
Even though the individual storylines are very much intertwined, we will attempt to split the whole story into bigger chunks and release an update when one of them is ready. In each chunk, the included storylines will be brought to some form of conclusion, or to a logical milestone (like in the demo). So you won't have to restart from the beginning each time we add new content.

With that being said, since this is a "choices matter" kind of game, we [i]do recommend[/i] that you keep saves from different stages of your progress in case we need to make changes to parts that you have already played through. We will do our best to avoid these situations, but we can't guarantee that it won't ever happen.

[b]What exactly will the game include when we go into Early Access?[/b]
The game will be reasonably feature complete. That means it will include every feature and game mechanic that we [i]currently plan*[/i] to have in the final version of the game, except those that may be unique to certain puzzles which only appear towards the end of the story. The only difference between the Early Access version and the full release should be content: more story, more places to visit, more puzzles, more characters.

*Since player feedback may largely impact parts of the game we might add or change some features as development is progressing.

[b]Will it include Ulti** from the beginning?[/b]
Yes, absolutely!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847091/f9b100e8e3fed9b651f98b25c12ae974b2d1e202.png[/img]

**Ulti is a card game that you will be able to play with most characters in the game.

[b]What about localisation?[/b]
The list of supported languages will always be kept up to date on our Steam store page***. The list will always be reflecting the supported languages of the full game, even in Early Access.

***Currently, our demo is missing Hungarian voiceover from that list, but it will be added for Early Access and the demo will get an update at that time too!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847091/8d955e888d46efaa59044ad6a135d5016cb9ce58.png[/img]

[b]When is Early Access starting?[/b]
Our plan is to get everything ready for that [i]before this summer[/i]. 
We will announce it when we have an exact date.

[b]How to get involved?[/b]
The best way to do that is to join us on Discord here: http://discord.gg/fcmJt65Prm
We are a friendly bunch and it is also a good way get info about things happening to the game, whether you want to opt in to Early Access or not! So come along and say hi! :)

notes.title: New gameplay options added
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Based on player feedback we have added a short text near the cursor to show players what they are pointing at.
[*] We have also added a new feature which we named Streamer Mode. If you turn this mode on, you allow other players to join your game using a unique 4-letter code and to assist you by highlighting things (objects or conversation options) on your screen. 
[/list]

These functions can be turned on or off under Options -> Gameplay from both the main menu and the pause menu.

notes.title: Behind the Beyond on Kickstarter from 19th October
notes.notes:
We are super excited to announce that our Kickstarter campaign will launch on...

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarpunchgames/behind-the-beyond][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847091/75daa4f62e8ff485cf33529daa3b07ecef4de136.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/sugarpunchgames/behind-the-beyond]Sign up here[/url] to get notified when the campaign goes live!

[h2]Why Kickstarter?[/h2]
We are a small team of devs and artists. Our resources are limited, but with a successful Kickstarter campaign we would be able to make an even better game, with more features, more content and in less time. 

One of the most important aspects of extra content is localisations. We would have the opportunity to present this unique world and exciting story in more languages, with a possibility of voiceovers even!

[h2]What's in it for you?[/h2]
As a Kickstarter backer, you will have the opportunity to...
[list]
[*] get the full game at a discounted price (with an early bird discount in the first 24hrs)
[*] see some exclusive behind-the-scenes content
[*] have your name in the credits
[*] leave your mark in the game
[*] get your hands on some really cool merch
[*] receive our eternal, undying gratitude
[/list]

notes.title: Behind the Beyond Demo is now available
notes.notes:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1730490/Behind_the_Beyond_Demo

[h2]Demo features[/h2]
[list]
[*] About 60 mins of gameplay
[*] English voice over
[*] Beautiful, immersive scenes and funny characters with bad puns
[*] An RPG-like twist on the usual point & click controls
[*] Multiple ways to solve one of the stories
[/list]

If you think you have found a bug, or you are stuck and need help, feel free to contact us via any of the channels listed below.

E-mail: sugarpunchgames@gmail.com
Website: https://behindthebeyond.com/contact
Twitter: https://twitter.com/behindthebeyond
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/BehindTheBeyond

[h2]Mac and Linux users[/h2]
We are aware that in the current version, if you change resolution or switch between full screen and windowed mode it does weird things to the pause menu. We are working on a proper fix, but in the meaintime if you encounter this problem, restarting the game will fix it.
